Snowfall triggers matter: most contracts clear after 5 cm (2 in) of accumulation. Premium segments — snow-bird full-winter plans, accessibility needs, guaranteed pre-7 AM clearing — price above the standard band.

Seasonal contract vs pay-per-storm

Seasonal (flat price): one payment covers every clearing from 15 Nov to 1 Apr. You win in a heavy winter, the crew wins in a mild one — and your driveway is on a fixed route, so you're never scrambling mid-storm.

Per-visit ($35–$100): pay only when it snows. Cheaper in a mild Calgary chinook winter, riskier in Ottawa or Montreal — and per-visit customers are the first dropped when a big storm overwhelms a route.

Lawn care pricing (GTA estimates)

$45–$90 per weekly mowing visit — roughly $1,000–$1,800 for a full season. Spring and fall cleanups run $350–$900 each depending on lot size and leaf volume.

The crews that clear your snow all winter run mowing routes all summer. A snow + lawn bundle means one contract, one crew that already knows your property, and no spring scramble for a mower.

Plans for every kind of winter

Beyond the standard driveway contract — the situations Canadian homeowners actually search for.

Residential driveway contracts

The core service: driveway cleared after every snowfall trigger, all season, on a fixed route. Add walkway and front-step hand clearing so the mail carrier and your guests can reach the door safely.

Snow-bird winter plans

Heading south for the winter? A snow-bird plan keeps your home cleared and lived-in looking, keeps deliveries moving, and keeps you compliant with municipal clearing bylaws while you're away. Premium-priced, worth every dollar.

Seniors who can't shovel

Shovelling is a real cardiac risk. A seasonal contract means never lifting a shovel again — driveway, walkway and steps handled, with priority service for medical appointments and accessibility needs.

7 AM departure — priority dispatch

Need to be on the road by seven? Priority routes are cleared first, before the standard rotation. Tell firms your departure time in the request pack — it's a priced premium segment because route order is everything in a storm.

Commercial lots & condos

Parking lots, plazas, condo roads and rental properties: tractor and loader clearing, salting for liability, and service windows matched to your opening hours. Quoted per site visit — select "Commercial lot" in the form.

Ice melt & salting add-ons

Clearing moves snow; salt stops the ice sheet that forms after. Salting add-ons cover the driveway, walkway and steps after clearing or during freezing-rain events — the cheapest liability insurance a homeowner can buy.

Roof snow removal

Heavy roof loads and ice dams damage shingles and eaves. Roof clearing is quoted per job in mid-season — common in Montreal, Ottawa and Halifax after major storms. Ask for it in your request notes.

Lawn mowing subscriptions

Weekly mowing on a set day, edges trimmed, clippings handled — estimated $45–$90 per visit in the GTA, about $1,000–$1,800 a season. Bundle it with your snow contract and the same crew handles your property twelve months a year.

Spring cleanup

Winter debris, dead grass, first cut and bed clearing to open the season — estimated $350–$900. Book it with your fall contract signing and your spring slot is held before the rush.

Fall leaf removal

Full leaf clearing before the snow buries them — buried leaves kill grass by spring. Estimated $350–$900 bundled with fall cleanup. The natural last job before your snow contract starts on 15 November.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a seasonal snow removal contract cost in Canada?

For 2026–27, residential seasonal contracts are estimated at $600–$1,700 in the GTA, $400–$900 in Ottawa, $350–$1,200 in Calgary and $700–$1,500 in Montreal, compiled from provider rate cards in September 2026. Other metros are quoted per property, with per-visit clearing at $35–$100 as the benchmark. Driveway size, walkway add-ons and priority timing move the price within the band.

When does the 2026–27 season run, and when should I book?

Standard contracts run 15 November 2026 to 1 April 2027. October is booking season — book then. Firms report prices rise and routes fill once the first storm hits, and mid-season sign-ups are often waitlisted.

Seasonal contract or pay-per-visit — which is better?

Seasonal is one flat price for unlimited clearings: it wins in heavy-snow winters and guarantees your spot on a route. Per-visit ($35–$100) can be cheaper in a mild winter, but costs spike in a snowy one and per-visit customers lose priority during major storms.

What's included in a typical contract?

Driveway clearing after a set snowfall trigger (usually 5 cm), for the full contract season. Walkway and steps hand-clearing, salting, windrow clearing and priority timing are add-ons — name the ones you want in your request pack so quotes are apples-to-apples.

What is a snow-bird plan?

Full-winter clearing while you're away, so the property looks occupied, deliveries aren't blocked, and municipal bylaws are satisfied. It's priced as a seasonal contract with a premium, and it's one of the most in-demand segments in snow-belt suburbs.

How much does lawn care cost?

In the GTA, weekly mowing is estimated at $45–$90 per visit — roughly $1,000–$1,800 over a full season. Spring and fall cleanups are estimated at $350–$900. Most snow firms also run lawn routes, so a bundle keeps one crew on your property year-round.

Can one company really do both snow and lawn?

Yes — it's the standard model for Canadian landscaping firms: snow routes in winter, mowing routes in summer, same trucks, same crews. That's why the bundle exists in the quote form above.
